name: Google Business Profile Activity - Press Burger Portal

parameters.content:
Workflow: Google Business Profile Activity - Press Burger Portal

Before activating:
1. Apply supabase/migrations/20260603000100_create_gbp_activity.sql in Supabase.
2. Create an n8n generic OAuth2 credential named Google Business Profile OAuth2.
3. OAuth scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage
4. Redirect URI in Google Cloud must match your n8n OAuth callback URL.
5. The Google user authorizing OAuth must be Manager/Owner on Press Burger GBP.
